subject: Renewal: evidence intake + log retention alignment for AtlasRetail
messages:
From: Elena Perez <elena.perez@atlasretail.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@atlasretail.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal evidence & longer log window request

Hi Dylan / Laura,

As we move toward our November 30 renewal, procurement asked me to confirm two items that affect our SOW: (1) AtlasRetail needs a SOC 2 re-attestation covering the past 12 months, and (2) we need audit/log retention extended from 90 days to 365 days for the next 12-month term. Both items are prerequisites for our legal team to finish the amendment.

Can you confirm:
- Whether a refreshed SOC 2 report will be available to customers as part of the renewal package or if you can provide an interim attestation letter?
- Any technical constraints or additional costs for maintaining audit logs (API request traces, token-level metadata) for 365 days, and how Redwood recommends we handle secure access to those logs?

We'd like to finalize the amendment by 11/30. If helpful I can loop in our external auditor (Brightline Audit) to coordinate evidence pickup.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Perez
Sr. Security Operations Manager | AtlasRetail
elena.perez@atlasretail.com
(415) 555-0172

From: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
To: Elena Perez <elena.perez@atlasretail.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence & longer log window request

Elena, thanks — and great timing. Short answers up front: yes on SOC 2 re-attestation (we publish a refreshed report and can provide an interim attestation cover letter), and yes we can retain the requested audit artifacts for 365 days but there are two tradeoffs to call out: storage/egress cost and slight impact to our incident forensic retention policy (we keep high-fidelity raw traces for 90d, aggregated/archived records for 365d).

Proposed next steps:
- I'll share Redwood's evidence checklist and a secure upload path for any artifacts Brightline needs (attached: redwood_evidence_requirements_v2.pdf).
- Rishi and Priyom: can you review the retention ask and flag any infra changes required to extend the archive window to 365 days? If there's a capacity bump we should capture approximate monthly delta for inclusion in the amendment.
- Elena / Atlas: if Brightline will pull evidence directly, please share the auditor contact and we will set up RBAC + short-lived credentials to the evidence bundle.

Timeline: we'll aim to confirm feasibility and a cost delta by COB Monday 2026-11-23 so your legal team can get the amendment signed by 11/30.

Elena — forwarding the attachment + S3 sample we typically provide for log export.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | 650-555-0126

Attachments: redwood_evidence_requirements_v2.pdf, s3-export-sample.csv

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence & longer log window request

Thanks Dylan — quick infra readout:
- We can extend log retention to 365 days. Plan: keep raw per-request traces in a cold-tier S3 bucket compressed (gzip) with lifecycle rules; maintain an index (metadata) in our observability store for 365d.
- Estimated storage delta for AtlasRetail (current qps / token volumes) is ~2.3 TB/month; approximate monthly cost increase $1,450 (storage + retrieval buffer).
- Work needed: a one-time config change + apply lifecycle policy and enable cross-account encrypted export; ETA: 3 business days once we have a signed amendment and an upload destination.

Action items assigned:
- Priyom: please draft the minimal RBAC policy for auditor read-only access and the presigned-s3 process.
- Laura: can you confirm product acceptance (SLA impact) and whether we need a term addendum on log access escalation?

I'll prepare a short note for legal with the cost delta and implementation ETA to include in the amendment.

-- Rishi
